limitations: L1: A water gel composition, including (a) a hydrophilic network monomer, (b) a hydrophobic network monomer, (c) a zwitterionic compound, (d) a cross-linking agent, and (e) an initiator.
L2: The hydrophilic network monomer is selected from one or more of methyl methacrylate, acrylic acid, acrylamide, and N,N-dimethylacrylamide.
L3: The hydrophobic network monomer is selected from one or more of methyl acrylate, methyl methacrylate lauryl ester, methyl methacrylate isobornyl ester, styrene, and ethyl silane.

L4: The zwitterionic compound is selected from one or more of 3-(2-methylacryloyloxyethyl diethylaminoethyl) propylsulfonic acid salt, 3-(tri(2-hydroxyethyl)aminoethyl) propylsulfonic acid salt, 3-(acrylamidopropyl diethylaminoethyl) propylsulfonic acid salt, 1-(3-sulfopropyl)-2-ethylvinylpyridinium sweet potato alkaloid, 2-methylacryloyloxyethyl phosphocholine, and 2-[3-acrylamidopropyl] diethylaminoethyl 2'-isopropylphosphoric acid salt.
L5: The cross-linking agent is selected from one or more of polyethylene glycol diacrylate, N,N-bis(acryloyl) ethylenediamine, and diacrylate ethylene glycol.
L6: The initiator is selected from one or more of diphenyl ketone, α-ketoglutaric acid, and 2,2-diethoxybenzophenone.

L7: The water gel composition includes the following proportions of each component: (a) hydrophilic network monomer, 200-400 parts by weight; (b) hydrophobic network monomer, 50 parts by weight; (c) zwitterionic compound, 50-250 parts by weight; (d) cross-linking agent, 2-20 parts by weight; and (e) initiator, 0.5-5 parts by weight.
